# Sample emails and AI reply

These are real outputs from the seeded **Sankar Living / The Slow Morning Edit**
workspace. All addresses use the reserved `.example` domain and all sends in the
demo go to the private outbox — no real person is contacted.

## 1. Personalised initial email

**To:** Tara Menon `<tara@morningedit.example>`  
**Subject:** A slow-morning idea for Tara  
**Generated by:** Claude adapter or the guided local model, from the brand brief
and Tara's public bio, niche, location and recent series.

```text
Hi Tara,

I am Omprakash Suthar from Sankar Living — a small home and wellness studio from
Sankar Group. We make thoughtful linen, ceramics and daily rituals for slower
mornings.

I have been following your Morning Edit series, especially the piece about a
routine that does not begin with a phone. The way you make calm feel practical is
exactly the mood behind our new The Slow Morning Edit.

We would love to send you the collection and explore a paid collaboration: one
honest review post plus three stories, with full creative freedom. If it feels
aligned, I can share the one-page brief and a simple rate range.

Would you be open to a 15-minute call next week?

Warmly,
Omprakash Suthar
Creator Partnerships, Sankar Living

Not the right fit? Reply "unsubscribe" and I will remove you from all future
outreach.
```

Why it passes the brief:

- Names the sender, the brand and the exact campaign.
- Mentions a specific reason the creator was selected.
- Offers a concrete collaboration shape and keeps creative control with the creator.
- Has one clear, low-pressure call to action.
- Includes a working opt-out line and sender identification.
- No false urgency, no invented follower claims, no hype.

## 2. Follow-up email (day 4)

**To:** Meera Iyer `<hello@meeraeveryday.example>`  
**Subject:** Re: An everyday wellness idea for Meera  
**Trigger:** No inbound reply after the configured 4-day interval.

```text
Hi Meera,

Just floating this back to the top of your inbox in case it got buried. We are
still holding a place for two home creators in The Slow Morning Edit this month,
and your everyday wellness work is the first name that came to mind.

No pressure at all — if the timing is not right, a quick "not now" is completely
fine and I will close the loop.

Warmly,
Omprakash Suthar
Creator Partnerships, Sankar Living

Not the right fit? Reply "unsubscribe" and I will remove you from all future
outreach.
```

The second follow-up uses a different, shorter message and is sent only if the
first follow-up also received no reply. Follow-ups stop instantly when any inbound
reply arrives, when the creator declines, or when they opt out.

## 3. Inbound reply

**From:** Tara Menon  
**Subject:** Re: A slow-morning idea for Tara

```text
Hi Omprakash,

This is such a lovely note — thank you. The Slow Morning Edit sounds very close
to what I have been exploring lately, especially the idea of a routine that
leaves room for quiet.

I would be open to a conversation. Could you share the scope and the rough range
you have in mind?

Tara
```

## 4. AI classification

```json
{
  "category": "interested",
  "confidence": 0.94,
  "summary": "Tara is positive and wants scope plus a rough rate range before committing to a call.",
  "suggestedAction": "Send two clear collaboration options and propose a 15-minute call."
}
```

The classifier also recognises `pricing`, `collaboration`, `not_interested`,
`opt_out`, `question` and `other`. An explicit opt-out always wins over every
other keyword.

## 5. AI reply draft — waiting for human approval

**Subject:** Re: A slow-morning idea for Tara

```text
Hi Tara,

Thank you — that genuinely made my morning. I would love to keep this simple.

Two options:
1. The Slow Morning Edit: one 30s reel plus three stories, ₹25,000–₹35,000
   depending on usage rights.
2. A longer ambience film: one 60s reel, five stories and one still set,
   ₹45,000–₹55,000.

Both come with a full product box, full creative freedom, and no script approval
on your side. If either feels close, I can send the one-page brief and we can lock
a date.

Would Thursday or Friday suit a 15-minute call?

Warmly,
Omprakash Suthar
Creator Partnerships, Sankar Living

Not the right fit? Reply "unsubscribe" and I will remove you from all future
outreach.
```

The draft is never sent automatically. A human can edit it, regenerate it, or
send it from the Inbox screen. Sending updates Tara's CRM status and marks the
thread handled.

## 6. Pricing reply variant

Meera asks for budget and usage rights. The classifier returns `pricing` with
91% confidence, and the draft answers with a two-tier range, explains organic
usage, offers an optional 20% paid-amplification add-on, and asks for a date hold.

## 7. Opt-out handling

Ishaan replies "Please remove me from this list. Not interested." The classifier
returns `opt_out` (99% confidence), sets the lead to **Opted out**, removes them
from all future follow-up queues, and keeps the record for audit. The only
permitted action is one confirmation that they have been removed.
